style_prompt: A photorealistic, high-resolution studio product photograph of {label}, isolated against a SOLID PURE WHITE BACKGROUND (RGB 255,255,255) — the entire area not occupied by the subject must be flat, uniform, pure white, edge to edge. Do NOT use any other color or gradient for the background, no checkerboard, no gray, no vignette, no surface or table. Single subject centered with generous padding. Sharp focus, true-to-life colors, realistic surface textures, gentle soft-box lighting from upper-left, subtle ambient occlusion directly under the subject only if natural (no large drop shadow on the ground), no text, no labels, no plate, no cutting board, no other props unless explicitly named. The image should look like a premium grocery or cookbook ingredient photograph on a clean white seamless backdrop. Maintain consistency across the set: same lighting direction, same neutral white-balance, similar camera distance, similar visual weight, so the sprites feel like a coherent series.
